task: Launch our new payments product: assess the competitive risks, write the Stripe integration code, write the refund handler code, plan the four-week rollout, draft the launch announcement, and design a hero image for the landing page.

events.why: Each deliverable in the task—risk assessment, two code modules, rollout plan, announcement, and hero image—is a distinct output requiring a dedicated specialist. One agent per deliverable ensures concurrent, independent work without dependencies.

agents.label: Competitive risk assessment
agents.name: Analyst
agents.subtask: Assess competitive risks for the new payments product, identifying key competitors, their strengths/weaknesses, market positioning, and potential threats.

agents.label: Stripe integration code
agents.name: Coder
agents.subtask: Write production-ready Stripe integration code for the new payments product, including API setup, webhook handling, error handling, and unit tests.

agents.label: Refund handler code
agents.name: Coder
agents.subtask: Write refund handler code for the new payments product, implementing refund initiation, status tracking, idempotency, and integration with Stripe refunds API.

agents.label: Four‑week rollout plan
agents.name: Scheduler
agents.subtask: Create a detailed four-week rollout plan for the new payments product, outlining weekly milestones, resource allocation, go/no-go criteria, and communication schedule.

agents.label: Launch announcement draft
agents.name: Writer
agents.subtask: Draft the launch announcement for the new payments product, covering key features, benefits, target audience, quote from leadership, and call-to-action for press release and blog.

agents.label: Hero image design
agents.name: Imager
agents.subtask: Design a hero image for the landing page of the new payments product, reflecting brand colors, conveying trust and speed, suitable for responsive web use.
